PERIOD RECONCILIATION: the Pakistan Economic Survey 2023-24 reports 3,957 thousand nutrient tonnes for the same year, but that is PROVISIONAL and covers July 2023 - March 2024 only. NFDC's three closing months of the year (April-June 2024) add 243,719 + 244,426 + 366,877 = 855,022 tonnes; 4,816,067 - 855,022 = 3,961,045, which is 0.10 percent above the Survey's nine-month provisional figure - final revision and rounding, not an unresolved discrepancy. The completed NFDC year is therefore the adopted basis.
